title: Improve Terminal Integration Reliability Across Platforms and Shell Configurations

labels.name: Bot Responded
labels.description: Issue has received an automated response

body:
## Problem Cline's terminal integration frequently fails across different platforms, shell configurations, and environments, preventing users from accessing command output. This creates significant friction in the user experience and forces users to find complex workarounds. For example: • macOS users with zsh + Oh-My-Zsh configurations experience shell integration failures
• VSCode reaches terminal limits (100+ terminals) causing complete shell integration breakdown
• WSL and SSH container environments have inconsistent terminal integration support
• Different shell configurations (bash, fish, zsh) have varying levels of compatibility
• Model behavior inconsistencies where AI doesn't consistently use command output tools
• Commands using $PAGER (like psql, git log) never exit properly, causing Cline to lose command output context ## Solution 1. Enhanced Shell Compatibility Detection: Automatically detect and adapt to different shell configurations (zsh, bash, fish) and common plugin conflicts (Oh-My-Zsh) 2. Improved Terminal Management: Better handling of terminal lifecycle, automatic cleanup of unused terminals, and recovery from VSCode terminal limits 3. Platform-Specific Optimizations: Dedicated handling for macOS, WSL, SSH containers, and remote development environments 4. Fallback Mechanisms: Robust fallback strategies when shell integration is unavailable or fails 5. Configuration Guidance: Clear documentation and automatic detection of optimal VSCode terminal settings 6. Environment Variable Management: Automatically set PAGER=cat and other necessary environment variables for Cline terminal sessions to prevent interactive pager issues ## Related Issues • Closes [#276]() - Shell Integration disruption after extension updates
